caveats: Shared host, separate existing CPU quota instance. No exclusive physical-core reservation.
All96 tails intentionally failed at1iteration; only stage/map validity, no end-to-end speed or QoR claim.
Native max_rss is RUSAGE_SELF process lifetime high-water mark, rounded0.1MiB, not a stage-local live-memory peak. External5second sampling can miss short processes.
Cgroup counter deltas include other work in the instance; lack of throttling does not certify lack of interference.
Native wall timers rounded0.01s; tseng0.1–0.3s cannot support precise small-percent differences.
Speedup baseline is each method at1core, not stock VPR; paired medians differ from ratios of median times.
